```{r}
#Housekeeping
rm(list = ls())
graphics.off()

#load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggimage)
library(factoextra)
library(ggplot2)

```

# 3 Dimension Embedding
```{r}
#load in embedding

em3 <- read_csv("../results/embedding_3.csv")

```

```{r}
#remove labels, so just embedding matrix

em3_matrix <- em3 %>%
  select(starts_with("dim_"))
```

```{r}
#run PCA
pca_result3 <- prcomp(em3_matrix, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# PCA scores
pca_scores3 <- as.data.frame(pca_result3$x)
```

```{r}
# Add words back in
pca_scores3$word <- em3$word

```

```{r}
write.csv(pca_scores3, "pca_3_dim.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Eigenvalues

eigenvalues3 <- (pca_result3$sdev)^2

```

```{r}
pca_df3 <- data.frame(
  Principal_Component = 1:length(eigenvalues3),
  Eigenvalue = eigenvalues3
)

```

```{r}
#vector format

#PC1 v 2
pc12_3 <- pca_scores3[, c("word", "PC1", "PC2")]

pc12_vec3 <- list(
  word = pca_scores3$word,
  PC1 = pca_scores3$PC1,
  PC2 = pca_scores3$PC2
)

#PC1 v 3
pc13_3 <- pca_scores3[, c("word", "PC1", "PC3")]

pc13_vec_3 <- list(
  word = pca_scores3$word,
  PC1 = pca_scores3$PC1,
  PC3 = pca_scores3$PC3
)
```

```{r}
# Scree plot

ggplot(pca_df3,
       aes(x = Principal_Component,
           y = Eigenvalue)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Principal Components vs Eigenvalues",
       x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Eigenvalue") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
# Variance explained

explained_variance3 <- pca_result3$sdev^2 /
  sum(pca_result3$sdev^2)
cumulative_variance3 <- cumsum(explained_variance3)
explained_variance_df3 <- data.frame(
  Dimension = 1:length(explained_variance3),
  ExplainedVariance = explained_variance3,
  CumulativeVariance = cumulative_variance3
)

print(explained_variance_df3)

# Plot cumulative variance explained

p3_variance <- ggplot(explained_variance_df3,
       aes(x = Dimension)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = CumulativeVariance),
            color = "blue") +
  geom_point(aes(y = CumulativeVariance),
             color = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Variance Explained by PCA",
    x = "Number of Dimensions",
    y = "Cumulative Variance Explained"
  ) +
 theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    )
  )

p3_variance

```
```{r}
ggsave("../plots/dime3_pca_variance.png", plot = p3_variance, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

##Plot in PCA space
```{r}
# PC1 vs PC2

p3_pc12 <- ggplot(pca_scores3,
       aes(x = PC1,
           y = PC2,
           label = word)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA Space: PC1 vs PC2",
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2"
  ) +
theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    )
  )

p3_pc12
```

```{r}
# PC1 vs PC3

p3_pc13 <- ggplot(pca_scores3,
       aes(x = PC1,
           y = PC3,
           label = word)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.5) +
  # geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
  #            linetype = "dashed",
  #            color = "grey50") +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
  #            linetype = "dashed",
  #            color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    title = "PCA Space: PC1 vs PC3",
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC3"
  ) +
 theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    )
  )

p3_pc13
```
```{r}
ggsave("../plots/dim3_pca_pc1_pc2.png", plot = p3_pc12, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

ggsave("../plots/dim3_pca_pc1_pc3.png", plot = p3_pc13, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

ggsave("../plots/dim3_pca_pc1_pc2.pdf", plot = p3_pc12, width = 6, height = 5)

ggsave("../plots/dim3_pca_pc1_pc3.pdf", plot = p3_pc13, width = 6, height = 5)
```
